kind: cheap 30-epoch seed/trajectory screen; NOT the block-count experiment and NOT a capacity measurement
question: At seeds 1 and 2, do the 6-, 5- and 4-block configurations already show meaningful trajectory variation or changing architecture ordering within the first 30 epochs?

frozen.refinement_implementation: Phase 1 residual blocks; only the COUNT varies (trailing dilation-1 blocks removed, the 1-2-4-8 ladder kept intact)
frozen.loss: masked smooth L1, beta=1.0, valid = gt > 0 and gt < max_disparity
frozen.lr_schedule: CosineAnnealingLR T_max=200 -- FROZEN, deliberately not re-fitted to the 30-epoch budget
frozen.augmentation: random crop, per-image gain jitter sigma=0.1, no flip
frozen.initialisation: fresh per the established recipe; no checkpoint loaded

probes: exp_h2_seed_replication.stereo_probe and exp_h2_softargmin_scale.validation_stage_stats, imported unchanged; no new stereo metric introduced
validation_protocol: first 10 scenes of hailo_val, full 368x1232 frames, pooled over gt > 0; every 5 epochs plus epochs 1, 2
epoch_30_evaluation: all 40 hailo_val scenes, full frames, pooled over gt > 0 -- the existing evaluator, unchanged
materiality_band: NONE. The historical E3b/E3c band is invalidated; none reused, none invented before or after the results.
claim_ceiling: This 30-epoch screen does not establish the final 200-epoch capacity ranking.
